w:r.w:t: v3.0 — REST API Edition (Google Apps Script REMOVED)
Full Architecture • Google Sheets REST API + OAuth 2.0 • Module Specifications • Optimization Upgrades

ARCHITECTURE CHANGE v3.0: Google Apps Script Web App has been COMPLETELY REMOVED. The entire cloud backend now runs on Google Sheets REST API + OAuth 2.0. All functionality, logic, and features remain 100% identical — only the backend transport layer has changed.

A cloud-synced, AI-assisted Android POS and Inventory Manager designed for small shops (1–30 POS terminals). Each shop owner logs in with their own Gmail and all data is saved to their personal Google Sheet — zero shared backend, zero server cost. Priced at 2,500 PKR/month after a 5–6 month free trial. Target markets: Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, USA, Europe.

2. Optimization Upgrades — v3.0 REST API Edition

These 4 original optimizations remain fully intact. The only change is: wherever 'Apps Script' was mentioned as the mechanism, it is now replaced with 'Android client-side logic via WorkManager/Coroutines calling REST API'.
OPT-1: Google Sheets Time Bomb Fix (Volume + Tampering)
Fix A — Monthly Sharding (Volume Solution) — Now Client-Side
WorkManager PeriodicWorkRequest scheduled for 1st of every month at 00:01 AM (replaces Apps Script Time-Driven Trigger)
POST /v4/spreadsheets/{id}:batchUpdate → addSheet request with title = Sales_MMM_YYYY
SyncWorker writes to current active month tab only. getDelta() reads from all non-archived tabs via REST API.
Hard limit: 18,000 rows max. If exceeded mid-month, WorkManager force-creates overflow tab via batchUpdate.
Query speed stays consistent regardless of total business age.
Fix B — Hidden Raw DB + UI Trap (Tampering Solution) — Now Client-Side
Dashboard tab — visible to shop owner. Beautiful charts, READ ONLY via conditional formatting set by app.
SYS_DB_DO_NOT_TOUCH — hidden via REST API: POST batchUpdate → updateSheetProperties → hidden: true
On every sync cycle, Android app calls GET /v4/spreadsheets/{id} to verify all tabs and columns exist. Missing column = auto-recreated via batchUpdate.
SYS_DB tab is hidden via REST API call every time SyncWorker runs — replaces Apps Script hideSheet()
OPT-2: Over-Engineering Fix — The 'Casio Calculator' UI
This optimization is purely UI-side and is completely unaffected by the backend change.
3-Tap Rule intact: Tap 1 = Select item from Quick Grid. Tap 2 = Enter quantity/weight. Tap 3 = Complete payment. No change needed for this optimization.
OPT-3: Hardware Reality Fix — Performance on 2GB RAM Tablets
Standard Room SQLite — 10x faster reads. Security via Google Account OAuth 2.0 + hidden Sheet.
ML Kit activates ONLY when user presses Scan button. Auto-deactivates after 30s idle.
WorkManager runs ONLY when: device is Charging, OR screen is OFF. Rush time = sync paused.
OPT-4: Sync Conflict Fix — Append-Only Event Sourcing Ledger
Completely unaffected by backend change. The logic is: never save a balance — only append events. The REST API simply appends rows to the Khata_Events tab instead of Apps Script doing it.

3. Global Core Rules (Apply to Every Module)
Strict MVVM. Separate packages: ui/, domain/, data/, di/, utils/. UI → ViewModel → UseCase → Repository → SheetsApiClient. Hilt/Dagger for all dependencies.
All data saved to Room first. REST API sync happens in background. UI always reads from Room. Never reads directly from REST API.
sync_status: pending → synced ONLY after HTTP 200 OK from Sheets REST API. HTTP 429/500/timeout = remains pending. Exponential Backoff: 5s → 15s → 1min → 5min.
No unkillable processes. Android Foreground Service with notification 'Syncing Sales Data...' WorkManager handles all batch uploads. Zero ANR.
CHANGED: No dual-backend. No FeatureFlag needed. Google Sheets REST API + OAuth 2.0 is the ONE AND ONLY backend. No Apps Script code anywhere in the project.
Subscriptions via official Play Billing Library. No JazzCash direct links. No web payment pages. No PHA libraries.
ProGuard/R8 obfuscation mandatory in release. RootBeer root detection on startup. Rooted device = UI block + cloud log.
Startup: fetch min_version from Settings tab via REST API GET. Outdated = 3-day countdown. Day 4: full-screen block dialog.
Heavy calculations in Google Sheet formulas. App size under 25 MB. Camera scanner 480p/720p max. WorkManager sync: charging or idle only.

G-5 CHANGED: The old dual-backend strategy (Apps Script active, REST API dormant) is now eliminated. There is ONLY ONE backend: Google Sheets REST API + OAuth 2.0. Remove all FeatureFlag.kt, AppsScriptSyncImpl, and DataSyncInterface dual-impl code.

Kotlin project with strict MVVM + Clean Architecture. Packages: ui/, domain/, data/, di/, utils/. Wire Hilt/Dagger from day one.
Room Database (Standard SQLite — no SQLCipher per OPT-3). Every table must include: system_row_id (UUID, immutable PK), sync_status (TEXT default 'pending'), created_at, updated_at, pos_terminal_id.
Retrofit2 + OkHttp singleton. Base URL: https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/. Interceptor: auto-attach Bearer {access_token} to every request. Auto-refresh token on 401. Inject via Hilt.
NO FeatureFlag.kt. NO AppsScriptSyncImpl. NO DataSyncInterface dual-implementation. There is only RestApiSyncImpl which is the live, active implementation.
Material Design 3. Dark: #1A1A1A. White text. Accent: #1E88E5. Home screen = Giant Numpad + Quick Grid. Advanced features hidden in menu.
Startup: GET Settings tab row 1 via REST API. Fetch min_app_version cell. Compare with BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE. If outdated: 3-day countdown. Day 4+: full-screen block.
M2 — Offline Sync & Cloud Bridge (REST API Only)
COMPLETELY REMOVED from M2: doPost(e), LockService.getScriptLock(), SpreadsheetApp, Apps Script deployment URLs, Web App triggers, Time-Driven Triggers. None of these exist anymore.

SyncWorker.kt: batch-reads all 'pending' Room rows → builds JSON payload → POST to Sheets REST API: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}:append?valueInputOption=RAW. UUID duplication check: GET range before insert.

WorkManager PeriodicWorkRequest fires on 1st of every month. Creates new Sales_[MMM_YYYY] tab: POST batchUpdate → addSheet. Archives previous: POST batchUpdate → updateSheetProperties → rename to ARCH_Sales_[MMM_YYYY]. Hard limit: 18,000 rows/tab.

After each sync cycle, SyncWorker calls: POST batchUpdate → updateSheetProperties → hidden: true for SYS_DB_DO_NOT_TOUCH. Schema check: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{id} → verify sheetProperties. Missing tab = POST batchUpdate → addSheet.
WorkManager constraints: requiresCharging(true) OR requires device idle. Exponential backoff on failure: 5s → 15s → 1min → 5min. HTTP 200 OK → mark Room rows as 'synced'.
Sales debounce timer: 20s after first sale. All sales in window → single JSON array → one POST /values/{range}:append request. Avoids 60 req/min Sheets API quota.

Background Coroutine: every 60s, GET Settings tab (single cell) for last_updated_timestamp. If newer → GET /values/{range} for only updated rows (filter by timestamp column). UPSERT via system_row_id in Room.
Every item: system_row_id (UUID, never changes). barcode_id is a separate editable field. Renaming barcode never creates a duplicate row.
Delta Sync fetches ALL terminals' data — not just own. Every device is a complete replica. Terminal A can search/refund Terminal B's sale offline.

WorkManager daily trigger at 11:59 PM. Android app reads all Sheet tabs via GET /values/{range}, writes to backup Sheet via POST /values/{range}:append using backup spreadsheetId from Settings. Zero dependency on server.

Access token stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences. Refresh token used on 401 response via POST to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token. Auto-retry original request after refresh. If refresh fails: show re-auth dialog.
Google Sign-In via AppAuth Android library (OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow). Scope: openid, email, drive.file. Access + Refresh tokens stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences. Role-based routing after login.
Admin: add users, set passwords (hashed), assign roles. User records stored in Users_Permissions tab and mirrored to Room DB. Synced via REST API.
Admin Permission Manager checklist: per-user, per-Module, per-Option toggle. Stored as permissions_json in Room + synced to Users_Permissions tab via REST API.
Every screen checks current user's permission map on load. Remote revocation effective on next Delta Sync — no logout required.
After first OAuth login, PIN-based quick unlock for subsequent app opens. Avoids full OAuth flow on every session.
Manager: View Only / Cashier: Full Access
Manager: Full / Cashier: Own Terminal Only
Manager: Daily Sales / Cashier: Own Shift
Home screen = Giant Numpad (full screen) + Quick Grid. Search bar. Advanced Options hidden in hamburger menu. 3-tap sale rule: Select → Quantity → Pay.
Configurable grid of pinned items. Long-press tile → Admin PIN to edit daily rate. Cashier cannot edit price.
Loose item tapped → custom decimal numpad. Accepts: 1.5 (kg), 0.750 (grams). weight × admin_price_per_kg = total → cart.
NO real-time inventory check on POS screen — prevents lag during rush. Stock math happens in background when SyncWorker uploads sale row to Sheets via REST API.
Price per kg/unit set by Admin only. Fetched and locked during Delta Sync. Cashier UI has NO price field. Admin PIN for on-screen override.
Payment methods: Cash, Card, Wallet (JazzCash/EasyPaisa), Udhaar. Split: 3000 cash + 2000 card on single bill. All breakdowns in separate DB columns.
ON/OFF hardware print toggle on checkout. OFF = no ESC/POS command sent. Per-session preference.
Send via WhatsApp → phone input → bill text summary via Android native Intent → api.whatsapp.com. Zero API cost. Auto-saves to CRM.
Every receipt includes Invoice UUID as QR code for instant retrieval and fraud verification.
All Bluetooth/USB scanners treated as HID keyboards — no custom pairing. POS TextField listens for KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER and IME_ACTION_DONE to capture barcode and auto-trigger add-to-cart.
CameraX + ML Kit Vision. Resolution locked: 480p/720p MAX. Camera activates ONLY when Scan button pressed — deactivates after 30s idle. 1500ms debounce. Haptic + beep on success.

Raw ESC/POS commands only — no proprietary SDKs. Bluetooth: SPP UUID 00001101-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB. Wi-Fi: TCP/IP Port 9100. Supports 58mm and 80mm. Async Print Queue + Auto-Reconnect (3 retries).
Separate from ESC/POS. TSPL/ZPL coordinate commands for custom label sizes (1"x1.5" or 0.5"x1"). QR + Item Name on label. Bluetooth SPP streaming. No main thread blocking.
Add/edit/delete items. Fields: Item Name, Category, barcode_id (user-editable), system_row_id (hidden UUID), unit (KG/ML/PC/GM), price_per_unit, current_stock, low_stock_threshold.
On-device ML Kit Text Recognition V2. NO cloud Vision API. Capture → raw text → Regex: \d+(\.\d+)?\s*(mg|g|kg|ml|l|oz). Auto-fills form fields. Background thread.

If user enables cloud AI: compress image to Base64, send to Vision API with JSON extraction prompt. Parse: product_title, weight, suggested_price. Flush image from RAM immediately after. Never save images to DB.
Before OCR: ML Kit Barcode Scanner pass. Barcode found → barcode_id field populate. Not found → auto-generate CUST-100001 style alphanumeric ID.
ZXing library. barcode_id → high-density QR. Preview display. Quantity + label size selection. Pass to M5.4 TSPL engine for Bluetooth label printing.
Compare current_stock to low_stock_threshold on every Delta Sync. In-app notification + highlighted item in Inventory list + Admin dashboard log.

Customer profile: Name, Phone, WhatsApp. Khata: Append-Only Event Ledger. App SUMs events in real-time: Total Udhaar, Total Jama, Baqaya. REST API: POST /values/{Khata_Events range}:append for every new event. NEVER update existing rows.
One button: auto-generate text Statement of Account (all events, running balance). Fire WhatsApp native Intent to customer number. No paid API.

Fetch past invoice by QR scan or Invoice ID. Full cancellation or partial line-item returns. Condition toggle: Restock OR Damaged/Wastage. Refund method: Cash/Card Reversal/Khata adjustment. Log as negative sale row via REST API append.
Filter: Date/Time/Item/POS Terminal. Instant lookup by ID or QR. Reprint any receipt — reprinted copy MUST show DUPLICATE/REPRINT header in large text (fraud prevention).

Real-time monitors: Room DB count vs synced count, pending queue size, last sync timestamp. Till Management: opening cash, all payment type totals, expected drawer balance. Day Close LOCKED until pending = 0. CSV auto-backup on Day Close.
Admin only: log daily expenses (rent, electricity, wages). Net Profit = Revenue - COGS - Expenses calculated in Sheet formula. Summary on Admin dashboard.
Enable ProGuard/R8 in release build.gradle. Obfuscate all class/method names. Custom keep rules for Room entities and Hilt components needing reflection.
RootBeer on startup. Rooted = warning dialog + UI blocked + DB access prevented + cloud log of attempt.

Privacy Policy URL in listing and in-app Settings. Data disclosure: 'This app reads/writes only to your own Google Sheet (drive.file scope).' Runtime permissions: Camera, Bluetooth, Notifications. Never log/transmit user data to developer server.
5–6 month free trial via Play Billing Library. Monthly subscription after trial. States: PURCHASED, PENDING, EXPIRED, grace period. No external payment links.
Before Play Store submission: APK scan via App Signing checker. Remove unused permissions. Confirm no PHA-flagged libraries. Confirm no prohibited background process patterns.
